title.id: Pembaruan Versi v1.0.2 — Fitur Auto-Update dan Peningkatan Stabilitas
title.en: Version v1.0.2 Update — Auto-Update Integration and Stability Improvements

body.id: Rilis v1.0.2 menghadirkan integrasi auto-updater otomatis ke GitHub Releases, pembaruan in-place tanpa perlu uninstall, perbaikan penanganan server lokal, dan sinkronisasi cloud backend.
body.en: Release v1.0.2 brings automated GitHub Releases auto-updater integration, seamless in-place upgrades without uninstallation, local server handling improvements, and cloud backend synchronization.

items.id: Integrasi Auto-Update: Notifikasi pembaruan otomatis saat rilis baru tersedia di GitHub.
items.en: Auto-Update Integration: Automatic update notification when a new GitHub release is available.

items.id: In-Place Upgrade: Pemasangan pembaruan versi baru langsung menimpa versi lama tanpa perlu uninstall manual.
items.en: In-Place Upgrade: Installing a new version directly upgrades the existing installation without manual uninstallation.

items.id: Penyempurnaan Peluncuran Server: Server lokal otomatis terikat sebelum jendela antarmuka dimuat.
items.en: Server Startup Refinement: Local backend server automatically binds before the UI window is loaded.
